title: [WT-10G] Wrappers: sparse frozen-gate workspaces exclude .moe
description:
Objective: provide the .moe-free frozen-gate interface required by revised WT-S §2.2 L6 without changing shared-checkout gates. SPIDR Interface prerequisite extracted from WT-10 after its QA-driven contract expansion.
Deliverable: an explicit optional worktree-mode arm on existing run_frozen_gate (argument `worktree`; default shared) / Invoke-MoeFrozenGate (-WorktreeMode switch; absent preserves shared), plus gate_integrity_wt / Test-MoeGateIntegrityWorktree. Use worktree add --detach --no-checkout at the frozen commit, sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' '!/.moe/', then read-tree -mu HEAD, never core.sparseCheckout=false in this arm. Retain HEAD/write-tree/diff-files checks; clear skip-worktree/assume-unchanged only for paths outside .moe. A .moe directory/file/link before or after the gate is MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY and failure. Existing child supervision, evidence recording and owned cleanup remain in use. Add mirrored regression cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1. Four edited files: the wrappers and these harnesses; no held-out worktree-landing test edits.
NOT in scope: land lease, round limits, migration flags, publication protocol, daemon/proxy changes, resource settings or documentation sweep. WT-10 consumes this callable interface after it lands.
Verification from repo root: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh; on native Windows additionally node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell. Exact same source revision on both engines, no unavailable-engine pass. Shared-mode cases remain unchanged.
definitionOfDone: The worktree-mode gate command sees the exact frozen HEAD/tree and MOE_PROJECT_PATH pointing to its disposable root, with .moe absent despite tracked .moe records; both postflight harnesses prove it.
A gate that creates .moe/x, a file named .moe, or a dangling .moe link fails with MOE_WORKTREE_GATE_INTEGRITY; cleanup touches only owned scratch paths and source/control sentinels remain unchanged.
Tracked source mutations, including index flag hiding outside .moe, still fail integrity; excluded .moe index entries remain skip-worktree and do not materialize.
Existing shared-mode frozen-gate behavior and error handling pass unchanged; default calls still select shared behavior.
The named verification exits 0, native Windows PS5.1 postflight passes on the same revision, and both wrappers carry the same introduced MOE_WORKTREE_ codes.
